prompt:
Create one independent panel-ready character image featuring Путин.

Framing: crop-safe chest-up so the face, mouth, expression, and essential upper body remain inside the image.
Visible upper-body geometry: upright torso with visible shoulders.
Hands: keep hands outside the crop. Do not show resting or idle hands inside the frame.
Head: near-frontal head.
Gaze: from the viewer's perspective, gently turn the head and face toward the viewer's right (screen-right), and direct both eyes toward the viewer's right (screen-right). Do not point the head, face, or either eye toward the viewer's left (screen-left).
Facial expression: calm.
Background: solid matte fill. Do not invent a location, room, landscape, patterned backdrop, or scenic environment.
Color: full-color rendering consistent with the approved project style / style-anchor color treatment. Do not render grayscale or monochrome.

Role of the reference images:
Image 1 is the approved identity anchor for Путин. It controls identity.
Image 2 is the project style anchor. It controls rendering language only, never identity or staging.

Hard prohibitions:
- exactly one person; no additional people
- no nested panels and no split layout inside the generated image
- no borders, captions, speech bubbles, dialogue bubbles, logos, watermarks, or generated text
- no unwanted contradictory scene objects
- no grayscale or monochrome rendering

Generate only this single character image for later external assembly.

Target aspect ratio: 5:4.

The finished image must visibly match the described action, emotion, gaze, pose, and composition. Keep the face, mouth, expression, gesture, and essential upper body safely inside the image so placement zoom can be adjusted later without losing them.

Rendering language:

- minimal fine texture
- strong readability at small panel size

No text, speech bubbles, logo, or watermark.
